_meta.session: Session 77 — Qwen3.5-Omni + SensorFM + Rosetta Stone ECI parallel mining
_meta.notes: Parallel mining of 3 papers. Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus/Flash dominant audio + ASR + vision: LibriSpeech 1.11 WER (clean), 2.23 (other), VoiceBench 93.1, MMSU 82.8, RUL-MuchoMusic 72.4 (vs Gemini 59.6 +12.8pp). Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus MathVista mini 86.9 (was Exaone 4.5 85.0). Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash SuperGPQA 67.4 (was Qwen3.6-27B 66.0). SensorFM-B (Google) wearable health 35 tasks: Age Pearson r 0.920, BMI 0.809, Cardiovascular AUC 0.712, Diabetes Insulin Resistance AUC 0.761, Mental Health Med AUC 0.819. Epoch ECI top: GPT-5-Pro-high 2.65, o3-high 2.51, frontier growth 0.55 cap units/yr.
